description: Logical roles defined independently of any runtime. Capabilities required for a role are used to validate runtime assignments in adapter_matrix and at lease acquisition time.

orchestrator.notes: Only the holder of the active exclusive Orchestrator lease may perform these actions. Any compatible runtime may hold the lease.

architect.notes: DEPRECATED as first-class role (2026-06 per UE5-Agent-Substrate-Review). Convert usage to architecture-analysis playbook (agent_collab/playbooks/architecture-analysis.md) invoked inside Planner or by Orchestrator. Role entry retained only for capability registry during transition.

planner.notes: Read-only. Produces DAG with task_type, ownership, verification profiles, allowed_runtimes, etc. Must avoid overlapping ownership. May absorb architecture-analysis and external-research as structured attachments (see playbooks/).

researcher.notes: DEPRECATED as first-class role (2026-06 per UE5-Agent-Substrate-Review). Convert to external-research playbook (agent_collab/playbooks/external-research.md). Use for parallel read-only investigation only; no dedicated handoff for new work.

coder.notes: Runs in isolated worktree. Strict adherence to assigned file_ownership and generated_output_ownership. Never direct binary edits. UE5-specialized via ue5-* capabilities.

critic.notes: Read-only. Returns exactly one of APPROVED/REJECTED/BLOCKED with evidence. Enforces all ownership, vendor, and verification rules. Must remain independent of the producing coder.

documentor.notes: DEPRECATED as first-class role (2026-06 per UE5-Agent-Substrate-Review). Convert to documentation-update playbook + checklist (agent_collab/playbooks/documentation-update.md). Execute serially only after Critic APPROVED + promotion when docs_impact=true. Role entry retained only for capability registry during transition.
